create.title: The complete first-band M1 Gram lift returns at equal square-root capacity
create.statement_tex: Let J=sqrt(X), Q=J^(2/5), T=J^(3/5), B=C/T, and J^(13/18)<C<=J^(3/4). For each transition-flattened smooth nonaxial M1 component, the complete deep centered Kloosterman-product coefficient is the exact sum of distinct normalized physical ordered pairs. Its unnormalized Fejer A-process is the exact four-row Gram operator used in Rounds 87--89. The integer u=0 coefficient is the whole global diagonal and is owned once; on u!=0, successive complements give a disjoint R87/R88/R89/hard partition. Full-prime-power completed descent is exactly invertible because q^(-2) sum_u T_q(u)e_q(-ux)=w_q(x) and the p^(2j) descent factor cancels q^2=(p^j q')^2; restricted Fejer shifts retain total mass. The finite Toeplitz inequality gives |sum_b H_(b,D)(0)|^2 <<_epsilon X^epsilon(B/D)E_D. With C_82=B^3T^2Q^(-5/12), T_82=J^2/T, and full directed degree Delta asymp B^2, the deep capacity and target are (D/B)C_82^2 and (D/B)T_82^2. Hence Gamma_deep=Gamma_82^2 and the compulsory square root returns to equal Round-82 capacity. At B=J^(3/20), J^(1/6) is the Gram-space square of J^(1/12), not an additional linear loss. The q=8 residual retains full degree, so local period peeling gives no strict gain. This is a Gram-level capacity barrier, not a linear involution and not an estimate of the hard signed operator.
create.next_action: Estimate the canonical hard actual-symbol Gram operator jointly. Do not resume local period peeling unless it proves a strict capacity reduction.

update.statement_tex: Let J=sqrt(X), Q=J^(2/5), T=J^(3/5), and J^(13/18)<C<=J. In the first band J^(13/18)<C<=J^(3/4), transition errors and axes are separately target-safe. The same-residue mode, literal dual d=0, every 0<|d|<=D_1=floor(J^(87/140)), and the outer support collar are target-safe. Rounds 87--89 remove the certified same-group, coarse, good-prime, and bad-prime cell packages. Their complete transform chain reassembles exactly to the deep Fejer Gram lift of the Round-82 centered Kloosterman-product operator. Full-prime-power descent/inversion, all classes and signs, stationary weights, modulus multiples, Ramanujan terms, and the global u=0 diagonal are retained once. The deep target and full-degree capacity are (D/B) times the squares of the Round-82 target and triangle capacity, so the Gram-space gap J^(1/6) at top conductor square-roots exactly to the Round-82 gap J^(1/12). The canonical hard residual retains cells failing the conductor thresholds, full nonunit-K, affine/full-phase, projection-only, shallow, and aperiodic factors, with the actual fourfold symbol and full directed degree possible. No signed estimate for this core is proved. On J^(3/4)<C<=J, principal main, transition error, and axes remain open. No full first-band, upper-conductor, cone-edge, M9-M1, M9, or exponent estimate is proved.
update.next_action: Treat the displayed hard actual-symbol Gram operator as the canonical first-band M1 core. A valid next estimate must give joint signed cancellation and a strict capacity gain; local period peeling is closed.
